title: Carnivorous plants lose the chloroplast NDH complex repeatedly, irreversibly and at parasite-like rates: code, data and results
description: Analysis code, curated data, intermediate results and figures for a phylogenomic study of plastid ndh gene loss across 311 plastomes, with fossil-calibrated dating, trait-dependent models and a nuclear survey of 22 genomes.
notes: Supported by the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India (BT/BII04/035/98; BT/PR40263/BITS/137/80/2023). Data and figures are released under CC BY 4.0.
